title: Sohail Khan Reveals He Was Sexually Harassed as a Child, Opens Up About Telling Father Salim Khan Years Later
excerpt: The Bollywood actor disclosed the childhood trauma on Amazon Prime Video's Alliance, urging parents to create safe spaces for children to speak up.
body:
Key Takeaways
  • Sohail Khan revealed he was sexually harassed as a child on Amazon Prime Video's Alliance.
  • He confided in his father, Salim Khan, years later due to feelings of shame.
  • Khan encourages his children to speak up about bullying and abuse.
  • His ex-wife Seema Sajdeh is a wildcard contestant on the show.
  • Khan's disclosure highlights the stigma surrounding childhood sexual abuse in South Asian communities.

  • Sohail Khan revealed on Amazon Prime Video's reality show Alliance that he was sexually harassed as a child
  • He kept the trauma to himself for years before confiding in his father, veteran screenwriter Salim Khan, as an adult
  • The actor said shame — not fault — kept him silent, and now urges his own children to speak up about any abuse
  • His ex-wife Seema Sajdeh has entered the show as a wildcard contestant

Bollywood actor and filmmaker Sohail Khan has disclosed that he was sexually harassed during his childhood, a traumatic experience he carried in silence for years before finally telling his father, legendary screenwriter Salim Khan.

The revelation came during a candid conversation on Amazon Prime Video's reality show Alliance, hosted by Kunal Kemmu, where 16 celebrity contestants compete in a high-tech underground bunker for a Rs 1 crore prize.

Breaking the Silence

During a discussion about ragging and bullying with fellow contestants Arslan Goni, Ruhee Dosani, and Aly Goni, Khan shared the painful experience that has shaped his approach to parenting.

"I was sexually harassed by somebody when I was young, and I kept that within me for years," Khan said. "When I grew up and became an adult, I went and confided in my father."

"I told him, 'Daddy, this happened to me.' He said, 'Beta, you kept this inside you for so many years?' I said, 'I am so sorry, but I was so embarrassed to say it.' I was not at fault, but I felt ashamed."

— Sohail Khan on Alliance

His fellow contestants embraced him after hearing the disclosure. Khan, visibly emotional, explained that the experience has fundamentally influenced how he raises his sons, Nirvaan and Yohan.

A Father's Lesson

Khan said he constantly tells his children to come to him regardless of what they face. "I am very against ragging. I always ask Yohan and Nirvaan — 'Don't feel shy or embarrassed to come and tell me if somebody is bullying you' — because this happened to me," he said.

The 55-year-old actor, the younger brother of Salman Khan, also became emotional while talking about missing his family during the show's isolation. He acknowledged that despite years of hosting and judging reality shows, participating as a contestant gave him a new understanding of the emotional toll competitors endure.

"The show taught me something I had not learnt in 55 years," Khan said.

A Broader Conversation

Khan's disclosure adds his voice to a growing number of public figures in India and across the diaspora who have spoken about childhood sexual abuse. The topic remains deeply stigmatized in South Asian communities, where shame and family honor often prevent survivors from coming forward.

The reality show has also reunited Khan with his ex-wife Seema Sajdeh, who joined as a wildcard contestant. The former couple, who were married for 25 years, have maintained a warm and supportive relationship on the show. Khan publicly took responsibility for any mistakes in their marriage.

Alliance streams on Amazon Prime Video.
